kind.description: What writes the key: `config` is a `role` or `access` value in a robot's `fleetless.yaml`, `collection_schema` an `access` entry of a collection in an app's collections schema, `app_user` an app user who holds it, `invitation` an invitation that carries it, `app_default` an app's default role, `role_inherits` another role that inherits from it, and `org_default` one of the organization's defaults.

label.description: What a person reads to find the place: the robot name (`config`), the app name (`collection_schema`, `app_default`), the e-mail address of the app user or of the invitee (`app_user`, `invitation`), the name of the inheriting role (`role_inherits`), or the access kind of an organization default (`org_default`).

path.description: Where the key is written. For `config`, the place in the YAML, such as `services.arm_home.role` or `access.rules[1].role`; for `collection_schema`, the place in the collections schema, such as `collections.notes.access.update.own[1]`; for `role_inherits`, the key of the role that inherits from it, because display names are not unique; `null` for every other kind.

robot_id.description: The robot whose document holds the key (`config`); `null` for every other kind.

app_id.description: The app the key belongs to: the app whose collections schema holds it (`collection_schema`), or the app of the user, invitation or default role (`app_user`, `invitation`, `app_default`); `null` for every other kind.

user_id.description: The app user who holds the key (`app_user`); `null` for every other kind.

document.description: Which version of the document holds the key (`config`: the robot's configuration, `collection_schema`: the app's collections schema): the published one or the draft; `null` for every other kind.

new_version.description: For a published document (`config` or `collection_schema`), the version number a rename with `update_references` would give it, a copy that differs only in the key; `null` for a draft and for every place that is no document.
